text:
Maya R: Quick sync — CloudBridge integration demo + partner blog + marketplace listing. Need to lock routing and bench narrative by EOD Thu.
Samir P: ok on bench narrative. do we have sample queries to benchmark performance?
Maya R: yes, working doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/partner/CB-integration-bench (will add access)
Hao Li: demo env is ready but needs fixed credentials and sample data. I'll push an update today.
Jen K: I'll draft comms: webinar post, joint blog, and marketplace blurb. What messaging should we highlight? low latency / cost per token? or reliability?
Samir P: propose highlight: 'predictable latency at scale' + a short benchmark: p99 < 200ms on 512 tokens w/ batching. Need numbers from runtime.
Maya R: perfect. Samir owns benchmark deck. Hao owns demo env and a short script to reproduce numbers.
Hao Li: putting script in the repo:
```
python run_demo.py --model redwood-small --seq 512 --batch 8
```
I'll also output `latency_summary.csv` with p50/p95/p99.
Carlos M: I'll set up UTMs for paid social and partner paid. Use this base: `?utm_source=cloudbridge&utm_medium=partner-webinar&utm_campaign=cb-integration-apr26`
Jen K: Copy. For inbound routing — are we sending partner leads to joint intake form or to Redwood SDR + tag?
Maya R: Joint intake form preferred, then Zap -> Redwood CRM with origin tag `cb-webinar-2026`. Jen to build form, Carlos to add UTM mapping.
Jen K: I'll create Typeform and share link by EOD. Also will draft joint blog outline and assign authors.
Samir P: One ask — include small reproducible prompt set for the bench so partners can re-run.
Hao Li: will add sample inputs to repo and attach to the blog as appendix.
marketing-bot: Reminder — webinar recording will be auto-uploaded to Redwood Cloud > Assets after live :calendar:
Maya R: Who's presenting on the joint blog? Samir for benchmarks, Jen for narrative, CloudBridge to provide customer quote.
Carlos M: I'll coordinate paid timeline. Need final hero image and 2 variations for social by Wed.
Jen K: I'll ping design. @design-team please produce 1200x628 hero + 1080x1080 carousel by Tue.
Maya R: OK. Next steps: Samir bench numbers by Tue noon, Hao demo script + creds by Tue EOD, Jen Typeform + draft by Wed, Carlos ad assets ready by Wed.
Samir P: I'll also prepare a 2-slide TL;DR for sales with routing instructions.
Jen K: Perfect. tagging this thread as action items. :white_check_mark:
Carlos M: noted. will update calendar invite with intake form link when Jen posts it.
Maya R: thanks team. small follow-up — add UTM to the marketplace listing page too, so listings send leads same way.
Hao Li: done once we publish. creds for demo will go to shared vault and I'll notify support.
Maya R: last note — please log any changes to the benchmark script in the repo CHANGES.md so we can snapshot for the blog.
Samir P: done. :thumbsup:
Jen K: thanks all — will update thread when Typeform is live.
